root_cause.text: l2cap_sock_state_change_cb() dereferences chan->data (the socket pointer) without checking if it is NULL, allowing a null-ptr-deref when the channel’s associated socket has been freed or is not set.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL guard (`if (!sk) return;`) to l2cap_sock_state_change_cb(), explicitly replicating the same guard already present in l2cap_sock_resume_cb() and l2cap_sock_ready_cb(), indicating the callback was missing this necessary check.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a NULL check for the socket pointer in the L2CAP state change callback to prevent a null pointer dereference.
intent_record.what: Added a NULL check for the socket pointer (sk) at the beginning of l2cap_sock_state_change_cb, returning early if sk is NULL before accessing sk->sk_state.
intent_record.how: Prevents a null pointer dereference by ensuring sk is non-NULL before using it to set socket state or handle errors.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly adds a NULL check for the socket pointer in the L2CAP state change callback, which exactly addresses the vulnerability root cause of a null pointer dereference due to missing NULL check.
